queries.sql: WITH days AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), ordered AS (SELECT UserID, dom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY dom) AS rn FROM days), pairs AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN dom ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN dom ELSE 0 END) AS gap_days FROM ordered WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT gap_days, users, SUM(users) OVER (ORDER BY gap_days ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT gap_days, COUNT(*) AS users FROM pairs GROUP BY gap_days) AS g ORDER BY gap_days
queries.description: Distribution of the number of days between a user's first and second active day, with a cumulative count of returners.

queries.sql: WITH lost AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-08' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 EXCEPT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-08' GROUP BY SearchPhrase) SELECT h.SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS early_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, MAX(h.EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate < '2013-07-08' AND h.SearchPhrase IN (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM lost) GROUP BY h.SearchPhrase ORDER BY early_hits DESC, h.SearchPhrase LIMIT 30
queries.description: Lost keywords: phrases with at least 5 hits in the first week of July that never appear again afterwards.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchEngineID, rn, SearchPhrase, users FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase LIKE '% % %' AND SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY SearchEngineID, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each search engine, the three long-tail (three or more words) search phrases reaching the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS first_dom, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) + 7 AS d7_dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), r AS (SELECT f.UserID AS uid, 1 AS back7 FROM f JOIN d ON d.UserID = f.UserID AND d.dom = f.d7_dom) SELECT f.first_dom AS cohort_dom, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS retained_d7, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS d7_rate FROM f LEFT JOIN r ON r.uid = f.UserID WHERE f.first_dom <= 24 GROUP BY f.first_dom ORDER BY cohort_dom
queries.description: Classic day-7 retention: for each first-activity day of the month, the share of users who were active exactly seven days later.

queries.sql: SELECT tz.ClientTimeZone, tz.users, tz.hits_n FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_n FROM hits GROUP BY ClientTimeZone) tz WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.ClientTimeZone = tz.ClientTimeZone AND d.IsNotBounce = 1 AND d.HistoryLength >= 10) ORDER BY tz.users DESC, tz.ClientTimeZone LIMIT 30
queries.description: Lists client time zones that contain at least one deeply engaged hit (non-bounce with history length of 10 or more), ranked by users.

queries.sql: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY SearchPhrase), daily AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_phrases FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day) SELECT first_day, new_phrases, SUM(new_phrases) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_phrases FROM daily ORDER BY first_day
queries.description: Keyword discovery curve for the counter with the most search traffic: new phrases first seen per day and the running total.

queries.sql: WITH tc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY total DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), per_os AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM tc) GROUP BY CounterID, OS), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, OS) AS rn FROM per_os) SELECT r.CounterID, r.OS, r.rn, r.c AS os_hits, CAST(r.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.total AS share_of_counter, SUM(r.c) OVER (PARTITION BY r.CounterID ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_hits FROM ranked r INNER JOIN tc ON r.CounterID = tc.CounterID WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY tc.total DESC, r.CounterID, r.rn
queries.description: For the five busiest counters, the top three operating systems with their share of the counter's hits and a cumulative hit total.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY ad_share DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS ad_share FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each day, finds the two hours with the highest share of ad-engine hits among hours with at least 1000 hits.

queries.sql: SELECT m.CounterID, m.mobile_hits, m.mobile_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mobile_users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY CounterID) m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits g WHERE g.CounterID = m.CounterID AND g.HasGCLID = 1) ORDER BY m.mobile_hits DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Finds the sites with the most mobile-phone traffic that never received a single Google-click-ID (paid) hit.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchPhrase, CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) AS phrase_len FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) t ORDER BY phrase_len DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 40
queries.description: Lists the longest search phrases that are established, with at least 5 hits each, on both mobile and desktop devices.

queries.sql: WITH busiest AS (SELECT EventDate AS bd FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS first_hr FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT bd FROM busiest) GROUP BY UserID), per_hr AS (SELECT first_hr, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_hr) SELECT first_hr, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users, CAST(SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(new_users) OVER () AS cumulative_share FROM per_hr ORDER BY first_hr
queries.description: On the busiest day of the month, how the day's audience accumulates hour by hour based on each user's first hit hour.

queries.sql: WITH m AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM m) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT band_min, COUNT(*) AS mobile_users, SUM(CASE WHEN desk > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS also_desktop, ROUND(AVG(desk), 2) AS avg_desktop_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN m.mobile_hits = 1 THEN 1 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 21 END AS band_min, COALESCE(d.desktop_hits, 0) AS desk FROM m LEFT JOIN d ON m.UserID = d.UserID) x GROUP BY band_min ORDER BY band_min
queries.description: Mobile users banded by their mobile hit count, with how many of them also browsed from desktop and their average desktop hits.

queries.sql: SELECT days_to_click, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY days_to_click ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) ELSE 99 END) - MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS days_to_click FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1) t GROUP BY days_to_click ORDER BY days_to_click
queries.description: Shows the distribution of days between a user's first visit and first ad-driven hit, with a cumulative count of users.

queries.sql: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10') AS early_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS late_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS both_sides) AS retained_users ORDER BY early_users
queries.description: Counts users active in the first ten days, users active in the last eleven days, and users present in both periods.

queries.sql: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), d AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS dom, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS next_dom, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) SELECT cur.dom AS day_of_month, cur.c AS hits_today, COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS hits_prev_day, CAST(cur.c AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS BIGINT) AS hit_delta, cur.u AS users_today FROM d cur LEFT JOIN d prev ON cur.dom = prev.next_dom ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Day-over-day hit change for the busiest counter, computed by self-joining its daily aggregate on the previous day.

queries.sql: WITH spans AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, MAX(sec) - MIN(sec) AS span_sec, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS BIGINT) AS sec FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0) AS t GROUP BY TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND COUNT(*) <= 50), ranked AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, span_sec, hit_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY span_sec DESC, hit_cnt DESC, UserID, EventDate) AS rn FROM spans) SELECT TraficSourceID, rn, UserID, EventDate AS activity_date, span_sec, hit_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
queries.description: For each traffic source, the three moderately active user-days whose hits span the longest time within the day.

queries.sql: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_versions, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UserAgentMinor)) AS max_minor_len, SUM(CASE WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '%.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dotted_hits, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY minor_versions DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 25
queries.description: Browsers with the most distinct minor version strings, with the longest version string and the number of hits whose minor version contains a dot.

queries.sql: WITH adc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID), soc AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SocialNetwork <> '' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT a.CounterID, a.ad_hits FROM adc a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc s WHERE s.CounterID = a.CounterID) ORDER BY a.ad_hits DESC, a.CounterID LIMIT 15
queries.description: Lists the counters with the most ad-engine traffic that never received any social-network traffic.

queries.sql: WITH os_top AS (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 8), tz_users AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM os_top) GROUP BY OS, ClientTimeZone), ranked AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM tz_users) SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn
queries.description: For the eight busiest operating systems, lists the three client time zones with the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), s AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END AS phrases_capped, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(u.active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(u.hit_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_hits FROM u JOIN s ON s.UserID = u.UserID GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END ORDER BY phrases_capped
queries.description: Relates search variety (distinct phrases per searcher) to retention measured as active days and overall hits.

queries.sql: WITH first_ad AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID HAVING MIN(EventDate) <= '2013-07-24'), activity AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM first_ad) GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) AS days_after, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM activity a JOIN first_ad f ON a.UserID = f.UserID WHERE a.EventDate >= f.first_day AND CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) <= 7 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY days_after
queries.description: Retention curve: for users whose first ad exposure was on or before July 24, counts how many are active 0 to 7 days after that first ad day.

queries.sql: SELECT is_social, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(windows AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_windows FROM (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SocialAction <> '' OR SocialNetwork <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_social, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) AS windows FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS u GROUP BY is_social ORDER BY is_social
queries.description: Compares retention (active days) and window usage of users who ever performed a social action against everyone else.

queries.sql: SELECT s.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS engaged_searchers FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SearchEngineID, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID > 0) s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits e WHERE e.UserID = s.UserID AND e.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY s.SearchEngineID ORDER BY engaged_searchers DESC, s.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
queries.description: For each search engine, counts searching users who also produced at least one non-bounce hit anywhere.

queries.sql: WITH heavy AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), silent AS (SELECT UserID FROM heavy EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT h.UserID, h.searches FROM heavy AS h JOIN silent AS s ON h.UserID = s.UserID ORDER BY h.searches DESC, h.UserID LIMIT 50
queries.description: Lists heavy searchers (20+ searches) who never produced a non-bounce hit, ranked by search volume.

queries.sql: SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND ClientTimeZone IN (SELECT ClientTimeZone FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 8) GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone, rn
queries.description: The three search phrases with the most distinct users in each of the 8 busiest client time zones.

queries.sql: SELECT FlashMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT FlashMinor2) AS minor_variants, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN FlashMinor2 = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_minor2, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(FlashMinor2)) AS max_minor2_len FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY total_hits DESC, FlashMajor LIMIT 30
queries.description: For each Flash major version with more than 1000 hits, counts the distinct FlashMinor2 strings, the hits with an empty FlashMinor2 and the longest FlashMinor2.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT WatchID) AS distinct_watches, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Gives the daily profile of the busiest counter: hits, distinct watch IDs, users and refreshes.

queries.sql: WITH top_lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 8), lh AS (SELECT h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits AS h JOIN top_lang AS t ON h.BrowserLanguage = t.BrowserLanguage GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight), r AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, WindowClientHeight) AS rk FROM lh) SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, rk FROM r WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rk
queries.description: For the 8 most common browser languages, shows the three most frequent window heights and their user counts.

queries.sql: WITH cs AS (SELECT CounterID, IsOldCounter, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(FetchTiming) AS f FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, IsOldCounter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) SELECT o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter, o.c, o.f FROM cs o WHERE o.f > (SELECT AVG(i.f) FROM cs i WHERE i.IsOldCounter = o.IsOldCounter) ORDER BY o.c DESC, o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter LIMIT 20
queries.description: Finds busy counters whose average fetch timing is slower than the average of counters with the same old-counter flag.

queries.sql: SELECT UserAgentMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS week1_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-15') AS c) GROUP BY UserAgentMajor ORDER BY churned_users DESC, UserAgentMajor LIMIT 15
queries.description: Browser versions of first-week users who never came back in the second half of the month.

queries.sql: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) AS local_day, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gclid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE LocalEventTime >= '2013-07-01 00:00:00' AND LocalEventTime < '2013-08-01 00:00:00' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY local_day
queries.description: For the counter with the most ad-engine hits, gives the hits, ad hits, GCLID hits and users for each local calendar day of July 2013.

queries.sql: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS d0 FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY UserID), daily AS (SELECT d0, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY d0) SELECT d0, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY d0 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM daily ORDER BY d0
queries.description: For the busiest site, counts newly first-seen users per day with a running total of acquired users.

queries.sql: WITH ad AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), nojs AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate) SELECT a.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_counters_with_nojs FROM ad a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nojs n WHERE n.CounterID = a.CounterID AND n.EventDate = a.EventDate) GROUP BY a.EventDate ORDER BY a.EventDate
queries.description: Per day, counts counters that received ad-engine traffic and also had JavaScript-disabled visitors on the same day.

queries.sql: SELECT scheme, tagging, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, AVG(url_len) AS avg_url_len, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%utm%' THEN 'utm' WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'query' ELSE 'plain' END AS tagging, CHAR_LENGTH(URL) AS url_len, UserID FROM hits) t GROUP BY scheme, tagging ORDER BY scheme, tagging
queries.description: Classifies landing URLs by scheme and campaign tagging, reporting hits, average URL length in characters and distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), monthly AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 500) SELECT m.CounterID, m.mau, AVG(d.dau) AS avg_dau, CAST(AVG(d.dau) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m.mau AS stickiness FROM monthly m JOIN daily d ON d.CounterID = m.CounterID GROUP BY m.CounterID, m.mau ORDER BY stickiness DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Ranks sites with at least 500 monthly users by stickiness, the ratio of average daily active users to monthly active users.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, rn, hr, users FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY users DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY activity_date, rn
queries.description: For each day, the two local-time hours with the most distinct active users.

queries.sql: SELECT min_engine, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(CASE WHEN last_hit > first_ad THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continued_after_ad, AVG(hits_that_day) AS avg_hits_per_user_day FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EventTime END) AS first_ad, MAX(EventTime) AS last_hit, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN AdvEngineID END) AS min_engine, COUNT(*) AS hits_that_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) t GROUP BY min_engine ORDER BY user_days DESC, min_engine
queries.description: For user-days that include an ad hit, grouped by the lowest ad engine ID seen that day, counts the user-days with any activity after the first ad hit and gives the average number of hits per user-day.

queries.sql: WITH ua AS (SELECT OS, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY OS, UserAgentMajor) SELECT os_id, ua_major, hit_cnt, rank_in_os FROM (SELECT o.OS AS os_id, o.UserAgentMajor AS ua_major, o.c AS hit_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ua i WHERE i.OS = o.OS AND i.c > o.c) + 1 AS rank_in_os FROM ua o) t WHERE rank_in_os <= 2 ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, os_id, ua_major LIMIT 40
queries.description: Ranks browser major versions within each operating system using a correlated count and keeps the top two per OS.

queries.sql: WITH no_gclid_regions AS (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY URLRegionID EXCEPT SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID) SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS ad_users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND URLRegionID IN (SELECT URLRegionID FROM no_gclid_regions) GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY ad_hits DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Among the URL regions that receive ad-engine traffic but never any GCLID-tagged hit, lists the twenty with the most ad hits.

queries.sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), newd AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_day), act AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS active_users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT act.EventDate AS activity_date, act.active_users, COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS new_users, CAST(act.active_users AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS BIGINT) AS returning_users, SUM(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY act.EventDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM act LEFT JOIN newd ON newd.first_day = act.EventDate ORDER BY activity_date
queries.description: Daily split of active users into brand-new and returning users, with a running total of all users acquired so far.

queries.sql: SELECT lang_len, is_lower, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT BrowserLanguage) AS variants FROM (SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(BrowserLanguage) AS lang_len, CASE WHEN BrowserLanguage = LOWER(BrowserLanguage) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lower, UserID, BrowserLanguage FROM hits) AS t GROUP BY lang_len, is_lower ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, lang_len, is_lower LIMIT 50
queries.description: Profiles the shape of BrowserLanguage values by length and casing to surface malformed language headers.

queries.sql: WITH top_phrases AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 200) SELECT t.SearchPhrase, t.c AS hit_count FROM top_phrases t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = t.SearchPhrase AND h.MobilePhone > 0) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, t.SearchPhrase LIMIT 50
queries.description: Among the 200 most popular search phrases, lists those that were also searched at least once from a mobile phone.

queries.sql: SELECT hr, rn, SearchEngineID, users FROM (SELECT hr, SearchEngineID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY users DESC, SearchEngineID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, SearchEngineID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime), SearchEngineID) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY hr, rn
queries.description: For each local hour of the day, the two search engines that brought the most distinct users.

queries.sql: WITH churned AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, MAX(EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM churned) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Finds the largest counters that were active in the first week but silent in the last ten days, with their last active date.

queries.sql: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS rate_vs_global FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY hits_n DESC, OS LIMIT 15
queries.description: Compares each large operating system's share of price-carrying hits with the global share, as a difference in rates.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_adv FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(same_day) AS same_day_users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.first_adv < s.first_search THEN 'adv_first' WHEN a.first_adv = s.first_search THEN 'same_time' ELSE 'search_first' END AS order_type, CASE WHEN CAST(a.first_adv AS DATE) = CAST(s.first_search AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS same_day FROM a INNER JOIN s ON a.UserID = s.UserID) x GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY users DESC, order_type
queries.description: For users with both searches and ad-engine hits, whether their first ad hit preceded their first search, and how many had both on the same day.

queries.sql: WITH w AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, ResolutionWidth, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND ResolutionWidth > 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, ResolutionWidth), m AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, MAX(c) AS max_c FROM w GROUP BY SearchEngineID) SELECT w.SearchEngineID AS search_engine, MIN(w.ResolutionWidth) AS top_width, m.max_c AS top_width_hits, COUNT(*) AS tied_widths FROM w JOIN m ON w.SearchEngineID = m.SearchEngineID AND w.c = m.max_c GROUP BY w.SearchEngineID, m.max_c ORDER BY top_width_hits DESC, search_engine
queries.description: For each search engine, finds its most common screen width by joining to the per-engine maximum count, taking the smallest width on ties and counting the tied widths.

queries.sql: SELECT WithHash, url_has_hash, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters FROM (SELECT WithHash, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%#%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS url_has_hash, UserID, CounterID FROM hits) AS t GROUP BY WithHash, url_has_hash ORDER BY WithHash, url_has_hash
queries.description: Cross-tabulates the WithHash flag against an actual '#' in the URL to find inconsistent, possibly forged, hits.

queries.sql: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(returning_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 10 / users) AS INTEGER) AS returning_decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(users) AS total_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, UserID) cu GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) c GROUP BY returning_decile ORDER BY returning_decile
queries.description: For counters with at least 100 users, computes the share of users returning on more than one day, then shows how many counters fall in each returning-rate decile.

queries.sql: WITH w1 AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w1 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 100), w4 AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w4 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-22' AND '2013-07-28' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT w1.CounterID, w1.users_w1, w4.users_w4, CAST(w4.users_w4 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / w1.users_w1 AS growth FROM w1 JOIN w4 ON w1.CounterID = w4.CounterID ORDER BY growth DESC, w1.CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Finds the counters whose distinct users grew the most from the first week of July to the fourth week.

queries.sql: SELECT stage_no, stage_name, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(MAX(users) OVER (), 0) AS conv_from_top FROM (SELECT 1 AS stage_no, 'visit' AS stage_name, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'returning_history', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE HistoryLength > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'engaged', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'event', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE IsEvent = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'priced', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE ParamPrice > 0) f ORDER BY stage_no
queries.description: Builds a five-stage user funnel (visit, history, engagement, event, priced hit) with conversion relative to the top of the funnel.

queries.sql: SELECT TraficSourceID AS first_source, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID)) t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY users DESC, first_source
queries.description: First-touch attribution: for users who ever had an ad-engine hit, finds the traffic source of their very first hit and counts users per source.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*), 4) AS search_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > 2 * (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY search_share DESC, hits_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Search-dependent sites: counters whose share of search-referred hits is more than twice the global share.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), per_counter AS (SELECT CounterID, MAX(c) AS peak, SUM(c) AS total, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM daily GROUP BY CounterID HAVING SUM(c) >= 500) SELECT burst_class, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(total) AS hits_cnt, MIN(active_days) AS min_days, MAX(active_days) AS max_days FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(peak AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * active_days / total >= 5 THEN 'extreme' WHEN CAST(peak AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * active_days / total >= 2 THEN 'bursty' ELSE 'steady' END AS burst_class, total, active_days FROM per_counter) AS c GROUP BY burst_class ORDER BY counters DESC, burst_class
queries.description: Classifies sites by how far their peak day exceeds their mean daily traffic and summarizes each burstiness class.

queries.sql: WITH top_counters AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), url_counts AS (SELECT CounterID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counters) AND URL <> '' GROUP BY CounterID, URL), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, URL, views, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY views DESC, URL) AS rn FROM url_counts) SELECT CounterID, rn, URL, views FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY CounterID, rn
queries.description: Lists the three most viewed URLs for each of the five busiest counters.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, SUM(IsEvent) AS events, CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS event_rate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate HAVING CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) >= (SELECT CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Lists the days whose event-hit rate is at or above the overall event rate for the whole month.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS nonsearch_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase = '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) > 30) GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Daily non-search activity of users who have at some point typed a long-tail search query of more than 30 characters.

queries.sql: WITH dc AS (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, CounterID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, hit_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM dc) SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS days_as_leader, MIN(hit_cnt) AS min_leading_hits, MAX(hit_cnt) AS max_leading_hits FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY days_as_leader DESC, CounterID
queries.description: Determines the busiest counter of each day and counts how many days each counter held the lead.

queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 50) AS t) GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), g AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, users, LAG(users) OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY EventDate) AS prev_users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY EventDate) AS rn FROM d) SELECT CounterID, EventDate, users, prev_users, COALESCE(CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(prev_users, 0), 0) AS growth FROM g WHERE rn > 1 ORDER BY growth DESC, CounterID, EventDate LIMIT 25
queries.description: Among the 50 busiest sites, finds the largest day-over-day jumps in distinct users, a sign of injected traffic.

queries.sql: WITH top_urls AS (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC, URL LIMIT 200), dead AS (SELECT URL FROM top_urls EXCEPT SELECT Referer FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '') SELECT COUNT(*) AS dead_end_pages, COALESCE(SUM(t.c), 0) AS dead_end_hits FROM top_urls t JOIN dead d ON t.URL = d.URL ORDER BY dead_end_pages
queries.description: Among the 200 most viewed pages, how many never appear as a referer of any hit (dead-end pages) and how many views they carry.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, ROUND(AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)), 2) AS avg_len, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*), 4) AS long_tail_share, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)) AS max_len FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY long_tail_share DESC, SearchEngineID
queries.description: Per search engine, average phrase length in characters and the share of long-tail phrases longer than 30 characters.

queries.sql: WITH ph AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID > 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase) SELECT p.SearchEngineID, p.SearchPhrase, p.c AS hit_count FROM ph p WHERE p.c = (SELECT MAX(p2.c) FROM ph p2 WHERE p2.SearchEngineID = p.SearchEngineID) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, p.SearchEngineID, p.SearchPhrase LIMIT 50
queries.description: Returns the most frequent search phrase or phrases of each search engine, using a correlated subquery for the per-engine maximum.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hidden_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS share_vs_overall FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY activity_date
queries.description: Daily share of hidden traffic (not-counted or artificial hits) relative to the share over the whole month.

queries.sql: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), daily AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_day) SELECT d.first_day, d.new_users, COALESCE(p.new_users, 0) AS prev_day_new_users, CAST(d.new_users AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(p.new_users, 0) AS BIGINT) AS delta FROM daily d LEFT JOIN daily p ON p.first_day = d.first_day - 1 ORDER BY d.first_day
queries.description: Counts newly acquired users per day (by first-seen date) and the change versus the previous day via a date-shifted self-join.

queries.sql: SELECT channel, URL, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'search' AS channel, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND URL <> '' GROUP BY URL ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL LIMIT 5) AS s UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'ads' AS channel, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY URL ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL LIMIT 5) AS a UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'referral' AS channel, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase = '' AND AdvEngineID = 0 AND Referer <> '' AND URL <> '' GROUP BY URL ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL LIMIT 5) AS r UNION ALL SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'direct' AS channel, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE Referer = '' AND URL <> '' GROUP BY URL ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL LIMIT 5) AS d) AS u ORDER BY channel, hits_cnt DESC, URL
queries.description: Top five landing URLs for each acquisition channel (search, ads, referral, direct) stacked in one list.

queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT HID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY HID) SELECT users_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hids FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN users >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE users END AS users_bucket FROM h) AS b GROUP BY users_bucket ORDER BY users_bucket
queries.description: Histogram of how many distinct users share each HID, capped at 10+, to spot shared hardware identifiers.

queries.sql: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' OR UTMMedium <> '' OR UTMCampaign <> '' OR URL LIKE '%utm_source=%') GROUP BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY search_hits DESC, SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Which search engines bring organic search hits from users who were also seen arriving through UTM-tagged campaign links.

queries.sql: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS ad_rate FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > 2 * (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY ad_rate DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Finds counters with at least 1000 hits whose ad-driven hit rate is more than twice the site-wide rate.

queries.sql: WITH cobalt AS (SELECT AdvEngineID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY AdvEngineID, EventDate), juniper AS (SELECT AdvEngineID, AVG(c) AS avg_c, COUNT(*) AS days FROM cobalt GROUP BY AdvEngineID) SELECT co.AdvEngineID AS adv_engine, co.EventDate AS spike_day, co.c AS day_hits, ju.avg_c AS avg_day_hits, ju.days AS active_days FROM cobalt co JOIN juniper ju ON co.AdvEngineID = ju.AdvEngineID WHERE co.c > 1.25 * ju.avg_c ORDER BY adv_engine, spike_day LIMIT 100
queries.description: Finds the spike days on which an ad engine's daily hits exceed its own average daily volume by more than 25 percent.

queries.sql: SELECT NetMajor, rnk, UserAgentMajor, hit_cnt, avg_fetch FROM (SELECT NetMajor, UserAgentMajor, hit_cnt, avg_fetch, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY NetMajor ORDER BY avg_fetch DESC, UserAgentMajor) AS rnk FROM (SELECT NetMajor, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, AVG(CAST(FetchTiming AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0 GROUP BY NetMajor, UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) AS a) AS b WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY NetMajor, rnk LIMIT 60
queries.description: Within each .NET major version, the three browser versions with the slowest average fetch timing among sufficiently used combinations.

queries.sql: SELECT a.UserID, a.avg_h AS early_height, b.avg_h AS late_height, ABS(a.avg_h - b.avg_h) AS height_shift, a.hits_cnt + b.hits_cnt AS total_hits FROM (SELECT UserID, CAST(SUM(WindowClientHeight) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS avg_h, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20) AS a JOIN (SELECT UserID, CAST(SUM(WindowClientHeight) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS avg_h, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20) AS b ON a.UserID = b.UserID ORDER BY height_shift DESC, a.UserID LIMIT 25
queries.description: Self-joins first-week and last-week user profiles to find active users whose average window height changed the most, suggesting device swapping.

queries.sql: SELECT hr, rn, SearchPhrase, c AS hit_count FROM (SELECT hr, SearchPhrase, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime), SearchPhrase) a) b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY hr, rn
queries.description: Top three search phrases for each hour of the visitor's local time.

queries.sql: SELECT FLOOR(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) / 10.0) * 10 AS title_len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchEngineID > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits, ROUND(AVG(HistoryLength), 2) AS avg_history FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY FLOOR(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) / 10.0) * 10 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY title_len_bucket LIMIT 40
queries.description: Relates page title length, in 10-character buckets, to search traffic and visitor history depth.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, hr, engaged_hits, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, engaged_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY engaged_hits DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) h) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY EventDate, rn LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each day, picks the three hours of the day with the most non-bounce hits.

queries.sql: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS early_users, SUM(CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS retained_users FROM (SELECT OS, UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY OS, UserID) t GROUP BY OS ORDER BY early_users DESC, OS LIMIT 15
queries.description: For each OS, counts users seen in the first week of July and how many of them came back in the last week.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Shows the days on which ad-engine hits exceeded the average daily ad-engine volume.

queries.sql: WITH early AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), late AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) SELECT e.SearchPhrase, e.c AS early_hits, l.c AS late_hits, CAST(l.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / e.c AS growth FROM early e JOIN late l ON e.SearchPhrase = l.SearchPhrase ORDER BY growth DESC, e.SearchPhrase LIMIT 25
queries.description: Search phrases with the fastest growth from the first half of July to the second half.

queries.sql: SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM (SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 INTERSECT SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) t ORDER BY UserAgentMajor LIMIT 50
queries.description: Lists browser major versions that have substantial traffic on both mobile and desktop devices.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, peak_hour, hour_hits FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS peak_hour, COUNT(*) AS hour_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS rn FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: For each day, the busiest hour of the day and its hit count.

queries.sql: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC) AS rnk FROM daily) SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_at_top, ROUND(AVG(rnk), 2) AS avg_rank, MIN(rnk) AS best_rank, MAX(rnk) AS worst_rank FROM ranked GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY avg_rank, TraficSourceID
queries.description: Stability of traffic sources: daily rank of each traffic source by hits, summarized as days at #1 and average rank.

queries.sql: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, AdvEngineID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_ad FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, AdvEngineID) SELECT a.AdvEngineID, COUNT(*) AS users_total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.first_ad > s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_after_search, SUM(CASE WHEN a.first_ad <= s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_before_search FROM a JOIN s ON a.UserID = s.UserID GROUP BY a.AdvEngineID ORDER BY users_total DESC, a.AdvEngineID
queries.description: For each ad engine, how many searching users first met the ad after versus before their first organic search.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) FROM hits) ORDER BY EventDate
queries.description: Days whose hit volume exceeds the average daily hit volume of the whole dataset.

queries.sql: SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, hit_cnt, CAST(hit_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tz_total AS share FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, hit_cnt, SUM(hit_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone) AS tz_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, hour_offset) AS rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, (CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) + 24) % 24 AS hour_offset FROM hits) x GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, hour_offset) g) r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone LIMIT 100
queries.description: For each declared client time zone, finds the dominant hour offset between client clock and server event time and its share of hits.

queries.sql: SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(OpenstatAdID) AS ad_id_len, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters, SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS adv_hits FROM hits GROUP BY CHAR_LENGTH(OpenstatAdID) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, ad_id_len LIMIT 20
queries.description: Distribution of Openstat ad identifier lengths with the number of counters and ad-engine hits per length.

queries.sql: WITH top3 AS (SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgentMajor ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, UserAgentMajor LIMIT 3), daily AS (SELECT EventDate, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, UserAgentMajor), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, UserAgentMajor, users, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY users DESC) AS daily_rank FROM daily) SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, UserAgentMajor, users, daily_rank FROM ranked WHERE UserAgentMajor IN (SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM top3) ORDER BY activity_date, UserAgentMajor
queries.description: Tracks the daily user-count rank of the three overall most popular browser versions across the month.

queries.sql: SELECT segment, counters FROM (SELECT 'retained' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS counters FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID INTERSECT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID) r UNION ALL SELECT 'churned' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS counters FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID) c UNION ALL SELECT 'new' AS segment, COUNT(*) AS counters FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID) n) u ORDER BY segment
queries.description: Counter retention between the first and last week of July: counters active in both weeks, only in the first, and only in the last.

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN refreshes = 1 THEN 1 WHEN refreshes <= 3 THEN 2 WHEN refreshes <= 10 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS vortex_level, COUNT(*) AS user_url_pairs, AVG(views) AS avg_views FROM (SELECT UserID, URLHash, COUNT(*) AS views, SUM(IsRefresh) AS refreshes FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, URLHash HAVING SUM(IsRefresh) > 0) t GROUP BY vortex_level ORDER BY vortex_level
queries.description: Classifies user-page pairs by how many times the user refreshed the same page (refresh loops) and their average views.

queries.sql: WITH searchers AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID, d), active AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS d, 1 AS seen FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, d) SELECT s.d AS day_of_month, COUNT(*) AS searchers, SUM(CASE WHEN a.seen = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returned_next_day, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN a.seen = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS return_rate FROM searchers s LEFT JOIN active a ON a.UserID = s.UserID AND a.d = s.d + 1 WHERE s.d < 31 GROUP BY s.d ORDER BY day_of_month
queries.description: Next-day return rate of users who arrived through a search phrase, per day of July.

queries.sql: SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(URL) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '/', '')) AS slash_count, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters, AVG(ResponseEndTiming) AS avg_resp_end FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CHAR_LENGTH(URL) - CHAR_LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '/', '')) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY slash_count LIMIT 30
queries.description: Distributes hits by URL path depth (number of slashes) with counter counts and average response-end timing.

queries.sql: WITH offs AS (SELECT ClientTimeZone, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) + 24) % 24 AS hour_offset, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-15' GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, (EXTRACT(HOUR FROM ClientEventTime) - EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) + 24) % 24), ranked AS (SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, c, SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone) AS tz_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY c DESC, hour_offset) AS rn FROM offs) SELECT ClientTimeZone, hour_offset, c, tz_total, ROUND(CAST(c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(tz_total, 0), 4) AS share FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY tz_total DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 50
queries.description: For each client time zone, the most common hour offset between client clock and server time on July 15 and how dominant it is.

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS ad_users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate

queries.sql: WITH cu AS (SELECT CounterID, UserID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, UserID), cstat AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN c = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS one_hit_users FROM cu GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT FLOOR(CAST(10 * one_hit_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / users) AS one_hit_decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(users) AS users_total FROM cstat GROUP BY FLOOR(CAST(10 * one_hit_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / users) ORDER BY one_hit_decile

queries.sql: SELECT cohort, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS engage_rate, AVG(HistoryLength) AS avg_hist FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE HTTPError > 0) THEN 'saw_error' ELSE 'clean' END AS cohort, UserID, IsNotBounce, HistoryLength FROM hits) c GROUP BY cohort ORDER BY cohort
queries.description: Compares engagement and history depth of users who ever hit an HTTP error page against users who never did.

queries.sql: SELECT kind, versions FROM (SELECT 'retired' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS versions FROM (SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion EXCEPT SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion) a UNION ALL SELECT 'introduced' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS versions FROM (SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion EXCEPT SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion) b UNION ALL SELECT 'persistent' AS kind, COUNT(*) AS versions FROM (SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion INTERSECT SELECT CodeVersion FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY CodeVersion) c) u ORDER BY kind

queries.sql: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM f GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day

queries.sql: SELECT a.CounterID, a.search_users, b.all_users, CAST(a.search_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / b.all_users AS search_user_share FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS search_users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID > 0 GROUP BY CounterID) a JOIN (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS all_users FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 1000) b ON a.CounterID = b.CounterID ORDER BY search_user_share DESC, a.CounterID LIMIT 20
queries.description: Ranks sites with at least 1000 users by the fraction of their audience that ever arrived from a search engine.

queries.sql: WITH h AS (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime) AS hour_start, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits WHERE DontCountHits = 0 GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)), r AS (SELECT hour_start, hit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DATE_TRUNC('day', hour_start) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, hour_start) AS rn FROM h) SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM hour_start) AS mon, EXTRACT(DAY FROM hour_start) AS dom, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM hour_start) AS peak_hour, hit_count FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY mon, dom

queries.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'none' WHEN SUBSTRING(Referer, 1, 8) = 'https://' THEN 'https' WHEN SUBSTRING(Referer, 1, 7) = 'http://' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS ref_scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' ELSE 'not_https' END AS url_scheme, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters FROM hits GROUP BY ref_scheme, url_scheme ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, ref_scheme, url_scheme

queries.sql: WITH d AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsLink = 1 GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT d1.EventDate, d1.c AS link_hits, (SELECT SUM(d2.c) FROM d d2 WHERE d2.EventDate <= d1.EventDate) AS running_link_hits FROM d d1 ORDER BY d1.EventDate

queries.sql: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS multi_hit_users, AVG(span_min) AS avg_span_minutes, MAX(span_min) AS max_span_minutes FROM (SELECT EventDate, UserID, MAX(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime)) - MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime)) AS span_min FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2) s GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate

translations.q006: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY SearchPhrase), daily AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_phrases FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day) SELECT first_day, new_phrases, SUM(new_phrases) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_phrases FROM daily ORDER BY first_day  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q010: SELECT SearchPhrase, lengthUTF8(SearchPhrase) AS phrase_len FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) t ORDER BY phrase_len DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 40  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q013: SELECT days_to_click, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY days_to_click ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) ELSE 99 END) - MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS days_to_click FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1) t GROUP BY days_to_click ORDER BY days_to_click  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q014: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10') AS early_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS late_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS both_sides) AS retained_users ORDER BY early_users  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q003: SELECT SearchEngineID, rn, SearchPhrase, users FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase LIKE '% % %' AND SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY SearchEngineID, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q004: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS first_dom, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) + 7 AS d7_dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), r AS (SELECT f.UserID AS uid, 1 AS back7 FROM f JOIN d ON d.UserID = f.UserID AND d.dom = f.d7_dom) SELECT f.first_dom AS cohort_dom, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS retained_d7, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS d7_rate FROM f LEFT JOIN r ON r.uid = f.UserID WHERE f.first_dom <= 24 GROUP BY f.first_dom ORDER BY cohort_dom
translations.q005: SELECT tz.ClientTimeZone, tz.users, tz.hits_n FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_n FROM hits GROUP BY ClientTimeZone) tz WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.ClientTimeZone = tz.ClientTimeZone AND d.IsNotBounce = 1 AND d.HistoryLength >= 10) ORDER BY tz.users DESC, tz.ClientTimeZone LIMIT 30
translations.q006: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY SearchPhrase), daily AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_phrases FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day) SELECT first_day, new_phrases, SUM(new_phrases) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_phrases FROM daily ORDER BY first_day
translations.q007: WITH tc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY total DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), per_os AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM tc) GROUP BY CounterID, OS), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, OS) AS rn FROM per_os) SELECT r.CounterID, r.OS, r.rn, r.c AS os_hits, CAST(r.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.total AS share_of_counter, SUM(r.c) OVER (PARTITION BY r.CounterID ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_hits FROM ranked r INNER JOIN tc ON r.CounterID = tc.CounterID WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY tc.total DESC, r.CounterID, r.rn
translations.q008: SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY ad_share DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS ad_share FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q009: SELECT m.CounterID, m.mobile_hits, m.mobile_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mobile_users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY CounterID) m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits g WHERE g.CounterID = m.CounterID AND g.HasGCLID = 1) ORDER BY m.mobile_hits DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 25
translations.q010: SELECT SearchPhrase, CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) AS phrase_len FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) t ORDER BY phrase_len DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 40
translations.q011: WITH busiest AS (SELECT EventDate AS bd FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS first_hr FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT bd FROM busiest) GROUP BY UserID), per_hr AS (SELECT first_hr, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_hr) SELECT first_hr, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users, CAST(SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(new_users) OVER () AS cumulative_share FROM per_hr ORDER BY first_hr
translations.q012: WITH m AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM m) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT band_min, COUNT(*) AS mobile_users, SUM(CASE WHEN desk > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS also_desktop, ROUND(AVG(desk), 2) AS avg_desktop_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN m.mobile_hits = 1 THEN 1 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 21 END AS band_min, COALESCE(d.desktop_hits, 0) AS desk FROM m LEFT JOIN d ON m.UserID = d.UserID) x GROUP BY band_min ORDER BY band_min
translations.q013: SELECT days_to_click, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY days_to_click ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) ELSE 99 END) - MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS days_to_click FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1) t GROUP BY days_to_click ORDER BY days_to_click
translations.q014: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10') AS early_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS late_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS both_sides) AS retained_users ORDER BY early_users
translations.q015: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), d AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS dom, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS next_dom, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) SELECT cur.dom AS day_of_month, cur.c AS hits_today, COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS hits_prev_day, CAST(cur.c AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS BIGINT) AS hit_delta, cur.u AS users_today FROM d cur LEFT JOIN d prev ON cur.dom = prev.next_dom ORDER BY day_of_month
translations.q016: WITH spans AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, MAX(sec) - MIN(sec) AS span_sec, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS BIGINT) AS sec FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0) AS t GROUP BY TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND COUNT(*) <= 50), ranked AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, span_sec, hit_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY span_sec DESC, hit_cnt DESC, UserID, EventDate) AS rn FROM spans) SELECT TraficSourceID, rn, UserID, EventDate AS activity_date, span_sec, hit_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
translations.q017: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_versions, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UserAgentMinor)) AS max_minor_len, SUM(CASE WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '%.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dotted_hits, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY minor_versions DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 25
translations.q018: WITH adc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID), soc AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SocialNetwork <> '' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT a.CounterID, a.ad_hits FROM adc a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc s WHERE s.CounterID = a.CounterID) ORDER BY a.ad_hits DESC, a.CounterID LIMIT 15
translations.q019: WITH os_top AS (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 8), tz_users AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM os_top) GROUP BY OS, ClientTimeZone), ranked AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM tz_users) SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn
translations.q020: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), s AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END AS phrases_capped, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(u.active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(u.hit_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_hits FROM u JOIN s ON s.UserID = u.UserID GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END ORDER BY phrases_capped
translations.q021: WITH first_ad AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID HAVING MIN(EventDate) <= '2013-07-24'), activity AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM first_ad) GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) AS days_after, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM activity a JOIN first_ad f ON a.UserID = f.UserID WHERE a.EventDate >= f.first_day AND CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) <= 7 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY days_after
translations.q022: SELECT is_social, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(windows AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_windows FROM (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SocialAction <> '' OR SocialNetwork <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_social, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) AS windows FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS u GROUP BY is_social ORDER BY is_social
translations.q023: SELECT s.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS engaged_searchers FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SearchEngineID, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID > 0) s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits e WHERE e.UserID = s.UserID AND e.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY s.SearchEngineID ORDER BY engaged_searchers DESC, s.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
translations.q024: WITH heavy AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), silent AS (SELECT UserID FROM heavy EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT h.UserID, h.searches FROM heavy AS h JOIN silent AS s ON h.UserID = s.UserID ORDER BY h.searches DESC, h.UserID LIMIT 50
translations.q025: SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND ClientTimeZone IN (SELECT ClientTimeZone FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 8) GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone, rn
translations.q026: SELECT FlashMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT FlashMinor2) AS minor_variants, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN FlashMinor2 = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_minor2, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(FlashMinor2)) AS max_minor2_len FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY total_hits DESC, FlashMajor LIMIT 30
