translations.q028: WITH top_lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 8), lh AS (SELECT h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits AS h JOIN top_lang AS t ON h.BrowserLanguage = t.BrowserLanguage GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight), r AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, WindowClientHeight) AS rk FROM lh) SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, rk FROM r WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rk
translations.q029: WITH cs AS (SELECT CounterID, IsOldCounter, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(FetchTiming) AS f FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, IsOldCounter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) SELECT o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter, o.c, o.f FROM cs o WHERE o.f > (SELECT AVG(i.f) FROM cs i WHERE i.IsOldCounter = o.IsOldCounter) ORDER BY o.c DESC, o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter LIMIT 20
translations.q030: SELECT UserAgentMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS week1_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-15') AS c) GROUP BY UserAgentMajor ORDER BY churned_users DESC, UserAgentMajor LIMIT 15
translations.q031: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) AS local_day, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gclid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE LocalEventTime >= '2013-07-01 00:00:00' AND LocalEventTime < '2013-08-01 00:00:00' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY local_day
translations.q032: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS d0 FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY UserID), daily AS (SELECT d0, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY d0) SELECT d0, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY d0 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM daily ORDER BY d0
translations.q033: WITH ad AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), nojs AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate) SELECT a.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_counters_with_nojs FROM ad a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nojs n WHERE n.CounterID = a.CounterID AND n.EventDate = a.EventDate) GROUP BY a.EventDate ORDER BY a.EventDate
translations.q034: SELECT scheme, tagging, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, AVG(url_len) AS avg_url_len, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%utm%' THEN 'utm' WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'query' ELSE 'plain' END AS tagging, CHAR_LENGTH(URL) AS url_len, UserID FROM hits) t GROUP BY scheme, tagging ORDER BY scheme, tagging
translations.q035: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), monthly AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 500) SELECT m.CounterID, m.mau, AVG(d.dau) AS avg_dau, CAST(AVG(d.dau) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m.mau AS stickiness FROM monthly m JOIN daily d ON d.CounterID = m.CounterID GROUP BY m.CounterID, m.mau ORDER BY stickiness DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q036: SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, rn, hr, users FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY users DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY activity_date, rn
translations.q037: SELECT min_engine, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(CASE WHEN last_hit > first_ad THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continued_after_ad, AVG(hits_that_day) AS avg_hits_per_user_day FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EventTime END) AS first_ad, MAX(EventTime) AS last_hit, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN AdvEngineID END) AS min_engine, COUNT(*) AS hits_that_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) t GROUP BY min_engine ORDER BY user_days DESC, min_engine
translations.q038: WITH ua AS (SELECT OS, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY OS, UserAgentMajor) SELECT os_id, ua_major, hit_cnt, rank_in_os FROM (SELECT o.OS AS os_id, o.UserAgentMajor AS ua_major, o.c AS hit_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ua i WHERE i.OS = o.OS AND i.c > o.c) + 1 AS rank_in_os FROM ua o) t WHERE rank_in_os <= 2 ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, os_id, ua_major LIMIT 40
translations.q039: WITH no_gclid_regions AS (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY URLRegionID EXCEPT SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID) SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS ad_users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND URLRegionID IN (SELECT URLRegionID FROM no_gclid_regions) GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY ad_hits DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q040: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), newd AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_day), act AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS active_users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT act.EventDate AS activity_date, act.active_users, COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS new_users, CAST(act.active_users AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS BIGINT) AS returning_users, SUM(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY act.EventDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM act LEFT JOIN newd ON newd.first_day = act.EventDate ORDER BY activity_date
translations.q041: SELECT lang_len, is_lower, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT BrowserLanguage) AS variants FROM (SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(BrowserLanguage) AS lang_len, CASE WHEN BrowserLanguage = LOWER(BrowserLanguage) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lower, UserID, BrowserLanguage FROM hits) AS t GROUP BY lang_len, is_lower ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, lang_len, is_lower LIMIT 50
translations.q042: WITH top_phrases AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 200) SELECT t.SearchPhrase, t.c AS hit_count FROM top_phrases t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = t.SearchPhrase AND h.MobilePhone > 0) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, t.SearchPhrase LIMIT 50
translations.q043: SELECT hr, rn, SearchEngineID, users FROM (SELECT hr, SearchEngineID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY users DESC, SearchEngineID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, SearchEngineID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime), SearchEngineID) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY hr, rn
translations.q044: WITH churned AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, MAX(EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM churned) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20

translations.q046: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_adv FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(same_day) AS same_day_users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.first_adv < s.first_search THEN 'adv_first' WHEN a.first_adv = s.first_search THEN 'same_time' ELSE 'search_first' END AS order_type, CASE WHEN CAST(a.first_adv AS DATE) = CAST(s.first_search AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS same_day FROM a INNER JOIN s ON a.UserID = s.UserID) x GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY users DESC, order_type

translations.q001: WITH days AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), ordered AS (SELECT UserID, dom, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY dom) AS rn FROM days), pairs AS (SELECT UserID, MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 2 THEN dom ELSE 0 END) - MAX(CASE WHEN rn = 1 THEN dom ELSE 0 END) AS gap_days FROM ordered WHERE rn <= 2 GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) = 2) SELECT gap_days, users, SUM(users) OVER (ORDER BY gap_days ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT gap_days, COUNT(*) AS users FROM pairs GROUP BY gap_days) AS g ORDER BY gap_days
translations.q002: WITH lost AS (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate < '2013-07-08' GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 EXCEPT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND EventDate >= '2013-07-08' GROUP BY SearchPhrase) SELECT h.SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS early_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, MAX(h.EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits h WHERE h.EventDate < '2013-07-08' AND h.SearchPhrase IN (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM lost) GROUP BY h.SearchPhrase ORDER BY early_hits DESC, h.SearchPhrase LIMIT 30
translations.q003: SELECT SearchEngineID, rn, SearchPhrase, users FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase LIKE '% % %' AND SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY SearchEngineID, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q004: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS first_dom, MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) + 7 AS d7_dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), r AS (SELECT f.UserID AS uid, 1 AS back7 FROM f JOIN d ON d.UserID = f.UserID AND d.dom = f.d7_dom) SELECT f.first_dom AS cohort_dom, COUNT(*) AS cohort_users, SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS retained_d7, CAST(SUM(COALESCE(r.back7, 0)) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS d7_rate FROM f LEFT JOIN r ON r.uid = f.UserID WHERE f.first_dom <= 24 GROUP BY f.first_dom ORDER BY cohort_dom
translations.q005: SELECT tz.ClientTimeZone, tz.users, tz.hits_n FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_n FROM hits GROUP BY ClientTimeZone) tz WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.ClientTimeZone = tz.ClientTimeZone AND d.IsNotBounce = 1 AND d.HistoryLength >= 10) ORDER BY tz.users DESC, tz.ClientTimeZone LIMIT 30
translations.q006: WITH first_seen AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY SearchPhrase), daily AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_phrases FROM first_seen GROUP BY first_day) SELECT first_day, new_phrases, SUM(new_phrases) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_phrases FROM daily ORDER BY first_day
translations.q007: WITH tc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS total FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY total DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), per_os AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM tc) GROUP BY CounterID, OS), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, OS, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, OS) AS rn FROM per_os) SELECT r.CounterID, r.OS, r.rn, r.c AS os_hits, CAST(r.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / tc.total AS share_of_counter, SUM(r.c) OVER (PARTITION BY r.CounterID ORDER BY r.rn ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_hits FROM ranked r INNER JOIN tc ON r.CounterID = tc.CounterID WHERE r.rn <= 3 ORDER BY tc.total DESC, r.CounterID, r.rn
translations.q008: SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, hit_cnt, ad_share, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY ad_share DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS ad_share FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) g) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q009: SELECT m.CounterID, m.mobile_hits, m.mobile_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mobile_users FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY CounterID) m WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits g WHERE g.CounterID = m.CounterID AND g.HasGCLID = 1) ORDER BY m.mobile_hits DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 25
translations.q010: SELECT SearchPhrase, CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) AS phrase_len FROM (SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone > 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 INTERSECT SELECT SearchPhrase FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) t ORDER BY phrase_len DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 40
translations.q011: WITH busiest AS (SELECT EventDate AS bd FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1), firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS first_hr FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT bd FROM busiest) GROUP BY UserID), per_hr AS (SELECT first_hr, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_hr) SELECT first_hr, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users, CAST(SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / SUM(new_users) OVER () AS cumulative_share FROM per_hr ORDER BY first_hr
translations.q012: WITH m AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS desktop_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM m) GROUP BY UserID) SELECT band_min, COUNT(*) AS mobile_users, SUM(CASE WHEN desk > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS also_desktop, ROUND(AVG(desk), 2) AS avg_desktop_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN m.mobile_hits = 1 THEN 1 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN m.mobile_hits <= 20 THEN 6 ELSE 21 END AS band_min, COALESCE(d.desktop_hits, 0) AS desk FROM m LEFT JOIN d ON m.UserID = d.UserID) x GROUP BY band_min ORDER BY band_min
translations.q013: SELECT days_to_click, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY days_to_click ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) ELSE 99 END) - MIN(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) AS days_to_click FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING MAX(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1) t GROUP BY days_to_click ORDER BY days_to_click
translations.q014: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10') AS early_users, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS late_users, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-10' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-21') AS both_sides) AS retained_users ORDER BY early_users
translations.q015: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), d AS (SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS dom, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) + 1 AS next_dom, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS u FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) SELECT cur.dom AS day_of_month, cur.c AS hits_today, COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS hits_prev_day, CAST(cur.c AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(prev.c, 0) AS BIGINT) AS hit_delta, cur.u AS users_today FROM d cur LEFT JOIN d prev ON cur.dom = prev.next_dom ORDER BY day_of_month
translations.q016: WITH spans AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, MAX(sec) - MIN(sec) AS span_sec, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 3600 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS BIGINT) AS sec FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0) AS t GROUP BY TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 AND COUNT(*) <= 50), ranked AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, UserID, EventDate, span_sec, hit_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY span_sec DESC, hit_cnt DESC, UserID, EventDate) AS rn FROM spans) SELECT TraficSourceID, rn, UserID, EventDate AS activity_date, span_sec, hit_cnt FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY TraficSourceID, rn
translations.q017: SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_versions, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(UserAgentMinor)) AS max_minor_len, SUM(CASE WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '%.%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dotted_hits, COUNT(*) AS hit_count FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY minor_versions DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 25
translations.q018: WITH adc AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID), soc AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE SocialNetwork <> '' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT a.CounterID, a.ad_hits FROM adc a WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM soc s WHERE s.CounterID = a.CounterID) ORDER BY a.ad_hits DESC, a.CounterID LIMIT 15
translations.q019: WITH os_top AS (SELECT OS FROM hits GROUP BY OS ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, OS LIMIT 8), tz_users AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE OS IN (SELECT OS FROM os_top) GROUP BY OS, ClientTimeZone), ranked AS (SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY users DESC, ClientTimeZone) AS rn FROM tz_users) SELECT OS, ClientTimeZone, users, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY OS, rn
translations.q020: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), s AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID) SELECT CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END AS phrases_capped, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(u.active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(u.hit_cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_hits FROM u JOIN s ON s.UserID = u.UserID GROUP BY CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END ORDER BY phrases_capped
translations.q021: WITH first_ad AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID HAVING MIN(EventDate) <= '2013-07-24'), activity AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM first_ad) GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) AS days_after, COUNT(*) AS active_users FROM activity a JOIN first_ad f ON a.UserID = f.UserID WHERE a.EventDate >= f.first_day AND CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) <= 7 GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY days_after
translations.q022: SELECT is_social, COUNT(*) AS users, AVG(CAST(active_days AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_active_days, AVG(CAST(windows AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_windows FROM (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE SocialAction <> '' OR SocialNetwork <> '') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_social, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days, COUNT(DISTINCT WindowName) AS windows FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) AS u GROUP BY is_social ORDER BY is_social
translations.q023: SELECT s.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS engaged_searchers FROM (SELECT DISTINCT SearchEngineID, UserID FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID > 0) s WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits e WHERE e.UserID = s.UserID AND e.IsNotBounce = 1) GROUP BY s.SearchEngineID ORDER BY engaged_searchers DESC, s.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
translations.q024: WITH heavy AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS searches FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), silent AS (SELECT UserID FROM heavy EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT h.UserID, h.searches FROM heavy AS h JOIN silent AS s ON h.UserID = s.UserID ORDER BY h.searches DESC, h.UserID LIMIT 50
translations.q025: SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY users DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM (SELECT ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND ClientTimeZone IN (SELECT ClientTimeZone FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY ClientTimeZone ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, ClientTimeZone LIMIT 8) GROUP BY ClientTimeZone, SearchPhrase) AS a) AS r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ClientTimeZone, rn
translations.q026: SELECT FlashMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT FlashMinor2) AS minor_variants, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN FlashMinor2 = '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS empty_minor2, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(FlashMinor2)) AS max_minor2_len FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000 ORDER BY total_hits DESC, FlashMajor LIMIT 30
translations.q027: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, COUNT(DISTINCT WatchID) AS distinct_watches, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes FROM hits WHERE CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q028: WITH top_lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 8), lh AS (SELECT h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users FROM hits AS h JOIN top_lang AS t ON h.BrowserLanguage = t.BrowserLanguage GROUP BY h.BrowserLanguage, h.WindowClientHeight), r AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, WindowClientHeight) AS rk FROM lh) SELECT BrowserLanguage, WindowClientHeight, hits_cnt, users, rk FROM r WHERE rk <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rk
translations.q029: WITH cs AS (SELECT CounterID, IsOldCounter, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(FetchTiming) AS f FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, IsOldCounter HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) SELECT o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter, o.c, o.f FROM cs o WHERE o.f > (SELECT AVG(i.f) FROM cs i WHERE i.IsOldCounter = o.IsOldCounter) ORDER BY o.c DESC, o.CounterID, o.IsOldCounter LIMIT 20
translations.q030: SELECT UserAgentMajor, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS churned_users, COUNT(*) AS week1_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-07' EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT UserID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-15') AS c) GROUP BY UserAgentMajor ORDER BY churned_users DESC, UserAgentMajor LIMIT 15
translations.q031: SELECT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) AS local_day, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS gclid_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE LocalEventTime >= '2013-07-01 00:00:00' AND LocalEventTime < '2013-08-01 00:00:00' AND CounterID = (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) GROUP BY CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM LocalEventTime) AS INTEGER) ORDER BY local_day
translations.q032: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), first_seen AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS d0 FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY UserID), daily AS (SELECT d0, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM first_seen GROUP BY d0) SELECT d0, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY d0 ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM daily ORDER BY d0
translations.q033: WITH ad AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), nojs AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate) SELECT a.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_counters_with_nojs FROM ad a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM nojs n WHERE n.CounterID = a.CounterID AND n.EventDate = a.EventDate) GROUP BY a.EventDate ORDER BY a.EventDate
translations.q034: SELECT scheme, tagging, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, AVG(url_len) AS avg_url_len, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS scheme, CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%utm%' THEN 'utm' WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'query' ELSE 'plain' END AS tagging, CHAR_LENGTH(URL) AS url_len, UserID FROM hits) t GROUP BY scheme, tagging ORDER BY scheme, tagging
translations.q035: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS dau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), monthly AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS mau FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 500) SELECT m.CounterID, m.mau, AVG(d.dau) AS avg_dau, CAST(AVG(d.dau) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / m.mau AS stickiness FROM monthly m JOIN daily d ON d.CounterID = m.CounterID GROUP BY m.CounterID, m.mau ORDER BY stickiness DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q036: SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, rn, hr, users FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY users DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime)) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY activity_date, rn
translations.q037: SELECT min_engine, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(CASE WHEN last_hit > first_ad THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS continued_after_ad, AVG(hits_that_day) AS avg_hits_per_user_day FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN EventTime END) AS first_ad, MAX(EventTime) AS last_hit, MIN(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN AdvEngineID END) AS min_engine, COUNT(*) AS hits_that_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN AdvEngineID <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) t GROUP BY min_engine ORDER BY user_days DESC, min_engine
translations.q038: WITH ua AS (SELECT OS, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY OS, UserAgentMajor) SELECT os_id, ua_major, hit_cnt, rank_in_os FROM (SELECT o.OS AS os_id, o.UserAgentMajor AS ua_major, o.c AS hit_cnt, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ua i WHERE i.OS = o.OS AND i.c > o.c) + 1 AS rank_in_os FROM ua o) t WHERE rank_in_os <= 2 ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, os_id, ua_major LIMIT 40
translations.q039: WITH no_gclid_regions AS (SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY URLRegionID EXCEPT SELECT URLRegionID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY URLRegionID) SELECT URLRegionID, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS ad_users FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 AND URLRegionID IN (SELECT URLRegionID FROM no_gclid_regions) GROUP BY URLRegionID ORDER BY ad_hits DESC, URLRegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q040: WITH firsts AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), newd AS (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM firsts GROUP BY first_day), act AS (SELECT EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS active_users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate) SELECT act.EventDate AS activity_date, act.active_users, COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS new_users, CAST(act.active_users AS BIGINT) - CAST(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0) AS BIGINT) AS returning_users, SUM(COALESCE(newd.new_users, 0)) OVER (ORDER BY act.EventDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM act LEFT JOIN newd ON newd.first_day = act.EventDate ORDER BY activity_date
translations.q041: SELECT lang_len, is_lower, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT BrowserLanguage) AS variants FROM (SELECT CHAR_LENGTH(BrowserLanguage) AS lang_len, CASE WHEN BrowserLanguage = LOWER(BrowserLanguage) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_lower, UserID, BrowserLanguage FROM hits) AS t GROUP BY lang_len, is_lower ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, lang_len, is_lower LIMIT 50
translations.q042: WITH top_phrases AS (SELECT SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchPhrase ORDER BY c DESC, SearchPhrase LIMIT 200) SELECT t.SearchPhrase, t.c AS hit_count FROM top_phrases t WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase = t.SearchPhrase AND h.MobilePhone > 0) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, t.SearchPhrase LIMIT 50
translations.q043: SELECT hr, rn, SearchEngineID, users FROM (SELECT hr, SearchEngineID, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY users DESC, SearchEngineID) AS rn FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS hr, SearchEngineID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime), SearchEngineID) AS a) AS b WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY hr, rn
translations.q044: WITH churned AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-08' GROUP BY CounterID EXCEPT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-22' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, MAX(EventDate) AS last_seen FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM churned) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q045: SELECT OS, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS priced_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ParamPrice > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS rate_vs_global FROM hits GROUP BY OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY hits_n DESC, OS LIMIT 15
translations.q046: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_adv FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT order_type, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(same_day) AS same_day_users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN a.first_adv < s.first_search THEN 'adv_first' WHEN a.first_adv = s.first_search THEN 'same_time' ELSE 'search_first' END AS order_type, CASE WHEN CAST(a.first_adv AS DATE) = CAST(s.first_search AS DATE) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS same_day FROM a INNER JOIN s ON a.UserID = s.UserID) x GROUP BY order_type ORDER BY users DESC, order_type
translations.q047: WITH w AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, ResolutionWidth, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchEngineID <> 0 AND ResolutionWidth > 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, ResolutionWidth), m AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, MAX(c) AS max_c FROM w GROUP BY SearchEngineID) SELECT w.SearchEngineID AS search_engine, MIN(w.ResolutionWidth) AS top_width, m.max_c AS top_width_hits, COUNT(*) AS tied_widths FROM w JOIN m ON w.SearchEngineID = m.SearchEngineID AND w.c = m.max_c GROUP BY w.SearchEngineID, m.max_c ORDER BY top_width_hits DESC, search_engine
translations.q048: SELECT WithHash, url_has_hash, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters FROM (SELECT WithHash, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%#%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS url_has_hash, UserID, CounterID FROM hits) AS t GROUP BY WithHash, url_has_hash ORDER BY WithHash, url_has_hash
translations.q049: SELECT CAST(FLOOR(CAST(returning_users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * 10 / users) AS INTEGER) AS returning_decile, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(users) AS total_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(CASE WHEN active_days > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS returning_users FROM (SELECT CounterID, UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS active_days FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, UserID) cu GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) c GROUP BY returning_decile ORDER BY returning_decile
translations.q050: WITH w1 AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w1 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-01' AND '2013-07-07' GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) >= 100), w4 AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_w4 FROM hits WHERE EventDate BETWEEN '2013-07-22' AND '2013-07-28' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT w1.CounterID, w1.users_w1, w4.users_w4, CAST(w4.users_w4 AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / w1.users_w1 AS growth FROM w1 JOIN w4 ON w1.CounterID = w4.CounterID ORDER BY growth DESC, w1.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q051: SELECT stage_no, stage_name, users, CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(MAX(users) OVER (), 0) AS conv_from_top FROM (SELECT 1 AS stage_no, 'visit' AS stage_name, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'returning_history', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE HistoryLength > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'engaged', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'event', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE IsEvent = 1 UNION ALL SELECT 5, 'priced', COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) FROM hits WHERE ParamPrice > 0) f ORDER BY stage_no
translations.q052: SELECT TraficSourceID AS first_source, COUNT(*) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, TraficSourceID, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn FROM hits WHERE UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID)) t WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY users DESC, first_source
translations.q053: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*), 4) AS search_share FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5000 AND CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) > 2 * (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY search_share DESC, hits_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 25
translations.q054: WITH daily AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), per_counter AS (SELECT CounterID, MAX(c) AS peak, SUM(c) AS total, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM daily GROUP BY CounterID HAVING SUM(c) >= 500) SELECT burst_class, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(total) AS hits_cnt, MIN(active_days) AS min_days, MAX(active_days) AS max_days FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(peak AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * active_days / total >= 5 THEN 'extreme' WHEN CAST(peak AS DOUBLE PRECISION) * active_days / total >= 2 THEN 'bursty' ELSE 'steady' END AS burst_class, total, active_days FROM per_counter) AS c GROUP BY burst_class ORDER BY counters DESC, burst_class
translations.q055: WITH top_counters AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 5), url_counts AS (SELECT CounterID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counters) AND URL <> '' GROUP BY CounterID, URL), ranked AS (SELECT CounterID, URL, views, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY views DESC, URL) AS rn FROM url_counts) SELECT CounterID, rn, URL, views FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY CounterID, rn
translations.q056: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, SUM(IsEvent) AS events, CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS event_rate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate HAVING CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) >= (SELECT CAST(SUM(IsEvent) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q057: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS nonsearch_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase = '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) > 30) GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q058: WITH dc AS (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, CounterID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, hit_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY hit_cnt DESC, CounterID) AS rn FROM dc) SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS days_as_leader, MIN(hit_cnt) AS min_leading_hits, MAX(hit_cnt) AS max_leading_hits FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY days_as_leader DESC, CounterID
translations.q059: WITH d AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID LIMIT 50) AS t) GROUP BY CounterID, EventDate), g AS (SELECT CounterID, EventDate, users, LAG(users) OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY EventDate) AS prev_users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY EventDate) AS rn FROM d) SELECT CounterID, EventDate, users, prev_users, COALESCE(CAST(users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(prev_users, 0), 0) AS growth FROM g WHERE rn > 1 ORDER BY growth DESC, CounterID, EventDate LIMIT 25
translations.q060: WITH top_urls AS (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY URL ORDER BY c DESC, URL LIMIT 200), dead AS (SELECT URL FROM top_urls EXCEPT SELECT Referer FROM hits WHERE Referer <> '') SELECT COUNT(*) AS dead_end_pages, COALESCE(SUM(t.c), 0) AS dead_end_hits FROM top_urls t JOIN dead d ON t.URL = d.URL ORDER BY dead_end_pages
translations.q061: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, ROUND(AVG(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)), 2) AS avg_len, ROUND(CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase) > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*), 4) AS long_tail_share, MAX(CHAR_LENGTH(SearchPhrase)) AS max_len FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY SearchEngineID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY long_tail_share DESC, SearchEngineID
translations.q062: WITH ph AS (SELECT SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID > 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase) SELECT p.SearchEngineID, p.SearchPhrase, p.c AS hit_count FROM ph p WHERE p.c = (SELECT MAX(p2.c) FROM ph p2 WHERE p2.SearchEngineID = p.SearchEngineID) ORDER BY hit_count DESC, p.SearchEngineID, p.SearchPhrase LIMIT 50
translations.q063: SELECT EventDate AS activity_date, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hidden_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits <> 0 OR IsArtifical <> 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS share_vs_overall FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY activity_date

translations.q067: SELECT SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS search_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE UTMSource <> '' OR UTMMedium <> '' OR UTMCampaign <> '' OR URL LIKE '%utm_source=%') GROUP BY SearchEngineID ORDER BY search_hits DESC, SearchEngineID LIMIT 20

translations.q070: SELECT NetMajor, rnk, UserAgentMajor, hit_cnt, avg_fetch FROM (SELECT NetMajor, UserAgentMajor, hit_cnt, avg_fetch, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY NetMajor ORDER BY avg_fetch DESC, UserAgentMajor) AS rnk FROM (SELECT NetMajor, UserAgentMajor, COUNT(*) AS hit_cnt, AVG(CAST(FetchTiming AS DOUBLE PRECISION)) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE FetchTiming > 0 GROUP BY NetMajor, UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) AS a) AS b WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY NetMajor, rnk LIMIT 60

translations.q073: SELECT FLOOR(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) / 10.0) * 10 AS title_len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS hit_count, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchEngineID > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits, ROUND(AVG(HistoryLength), 2) AS avg_history FROM hits WHERE Title <> '' GROUP BY FLOOR(CHAR_LENGTH(Title) / 10.0) * 10 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 ORDER BY title_len_bucket LIMIT 40
translations.q074: SELECT EventDate, hr, engaged_hits, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, engaged_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY engaged_hits DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, SUM(IsNotBounce) AS engaged_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) h) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY EventDate, rn LIMIT 100

translations.q076: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS ad_hits FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0) ORDER BY EventDate

translations.q078: SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM (SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 INTERSECT SELECT UserAgentMajor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserAgentMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) t ORDER BY UserAgentMajor LIMIT 50
translations.q079: SELECT EventDate, peak_hour, hour_hits FROM (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS peak_hour, COUNT(*) AS hour_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) AS rn FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) t WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q080: WITH daily AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EventDate, TraficSourceID), ranked AS (SELECT EventDate, TraficSourceID, c, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC) AS rnk FROM daily) SELECT TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS active_days, SUM(CASE WHEN rnk = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS days_at_top, ROUND(AVG(rnk), 2) AS avg_rank, MIN(rnk) AS best_rank, MAX(rnk) AS worst_rank FROM ranked GROUP BY TraficSourceID ORDER BY avg_rank, TraficSourceID
translations.q081: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_search FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT UserID, AdvEngineID, MIN(EventTime) AS first_ad FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, AdvEngineID) SELECT a.AdvEngineID, COUNT(*) AS users_total, SUM(CASE WHEN a.first_ad > s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_after_search, SUM(CASE WHEN a.first_ad <= s.first_search THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ad_before_search FROM a JOIN s ON a.UserID = s.UserID GROUP BY a.AdvEngineID ORDER BY users_total DESC, a.AdvEngineID
translations.q082: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS day_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate HAVING COUNT(*) > (SELECT CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) FROM hits) ORDER BY EventDate
